title: The Creature in the Picture
lines: Meg drew a picture of a creature.
It had ten legs and a big grin.
She hung it up next to her bed.
In the night the picture fell down.
The cat had made a mess of it.
Meg had to fix a big rip.
Now the creature has a patch on it.

questions.ask: How many legs did the creature have?
questions.listenFor: Ten. Line two, a quick one to find.
The cat. Meg did not know that until the next morning.

questions.ask: What would your creature look like? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. This one is worth drawing after.
